models.title: DTH-SFP overlay 0.1.0-draft.1
models.description: The dth-sfp overlay on the smart-ra (DPI-H RA) ArchiMate model 0.3.0-draft.1: the four substandard and falsified (SF) medical product reporting views (DIIG enterprise architecture, business process with SF-REP-001..006, application cooperation, regulatory governance). Elements tagged overlay:base copy a smart-ra element and name it by IRI; elements tagged overlay:dth copy a dth-phc overlay element; elements tagged overlay:owner=dth-sfp are this DTH's own.
